description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'CurrentAndChangeEntitlement' used within the OrangeHRM Leave Plugin to encapsulate current and change entitlement data related to leave entitlements, including getter and setter methods for the relevant properties.

classes.name: CurrentAndChangeEntitlement
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating current and changed leave entitlement data, with properties for current entitlements and changes, along with their getters and setters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DTO with optional arrays for current and change leave entitlements.

methods.name: getCurrent
methods.description: Retrieves the current entitlement data array.

methods.name: setCurrent
methods.description: Sets the current entitlement data array.

methods.name: getChange
methods.description: Retrieves the change entitlement data array.

methods.name: setChange
methods.description: Sets the change entitlement data array.
